svg.title: A 4 by 4 matrix on four GPUs under Replicate, Shard(0) and Partial placements
svg.text: DTensor: one logical tensor spread over many GPUs
Each placement says how the real data relates to the logical tensor.

svg.text: each GPU holds a slice of the rows
Memory per GPU drops by 4x. Reading a
full row means gathering the slices

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: each GPU holds one term of a sum
An all-reduce turns it into Replicate.
A reduce-scatter turns it into Shard.
A grid of GPUs with named axes, for example init_device_mesh("cuda", (2, 4), mesh_dim_names=("dp", "tp")).
A DTensor has one placement per mesh axis. Every operator has a sharding rule that says which collectives to insert.
